reviews.reason: The definition uses the repaired Choice-dependent nondegeneracy of the Killing form on the Cartan subalgebra; the public Choice assumption and direct axiom dependency now license that exact construction.
The proof uses both Killing orthogonality and the Choice-dependent root-space decomposition. Adding Choice to the statement, Given block, and dependencies is the minimal sufficient repair.

The contradiction proof depends on the Choice-scoped Killing-dual, opposite-root pairing, and root decomposition interfaces; the repair propagates Choice without changing the valid algebraic argument.
The line-identification proof invokes the repaired Killing-dual vector, Cartan nondegeneracy, and opposite-root pairing, all under Choice; its interface now states and declares that hypothesis.
The coroot denominator is supplied by the newly Choice-scoped Killing-length and dual-vector chain, so the definition now assumes Choice explicitly and declares the axiom dependency.
Existence and normalization of the root triple use the Choice-dependent coroot, dual-vector, and opposite-pairing results; the theorem now propagates Choice while retaining its sound proof.
The finite-dimensional sl_2 module argument starts from the Choice-dependent root triple and root decomposition. The theorem now exposes that inherited hypothesis at every public interface.
Integrality is deduced directly from the Choice-dependent root-string theorem and coroot construction. The corollary now carries Choice in its statement, facts, and dependency contract.
The reducedness proof uses Choice-scoped coroots, Cartan integrality, root triples, and opposite brackets. Propagating Choice licenses every load-bearing supplier without altering the proof.
The reflection formula presupposes the repaired Choice-dependent coroot. The definition now assumes Choice and declares it directly, which is sufficient for the existing involution calculation.
Reflection stability is proved through Choice-dependent root strings, integrality, and coroots. The theorem now propagates Choice through the statement, Given block, and dependencies.
The invariant-subspace trace proof uses the Choice-dependent root triple, coroot, opposite bracket, and decomposition. Its public interface now carries the exact inherited axiom.
The old chart argument relied on false inheritance by arbitrary open CGWH subspaces. The repaired compact-fibre lemma now supplies paracompactness, Hausdorffness, CGWH, and CW type directly.
Before invoking the Thom construction, the definition now records that the CW base is CGWH and that the compact-fibre lemma gives all three required total-space properties, including CGWH.
Each projectivization stage now gets CGWH directly from the compact-fibre lemma. The invalid claim that arbitrary open CGWH subspaces preserve compact generation was removed.
Fact F5 now states the supplier's conditional CGWH conclusion, and proof step 1.3 uses it to place the projective total space in the exact Thom-scope interface.
Every intermediate projective stage now invokes the compact-fibre lemma for paracompact Hausdorff, CGWH, and CW-type conclusions, licensing the projective-bundle theorem at the next stage.
The undefined admissible-base shorthand was replaced by the exact paracompact Hausdorff CGWH CW-type conditions, and F6 now propagates all four properties through every flag stage.
Both finiteness and infinite-mean suppliers concern one normalized everywhere-continuous zero-start representative. The counterexample now defines its hitting time from that identical representative.
The explanatory odd-Chern sentence now invokes the two-torsion corollary only for numerable bundles over path-connected paracompact Hausdorff CW complexes; the even-class definition is unchanged.
The concrete spectra are unchanged and valid, but the general-inclusion remark now states the repaired closed, same-unit subalgebra hypotheses, which the isometric disc-algebra image satisfies.
The multiplicity and arrow convention is mathematically unchanged, but its ratio-of-root-lengths argument now declares the rank-two classification that the definition cites directly.

The proof and Whitney product identity remain valid, but the public interface now replaces an undefined admissible-base shorthand with the exact paracompact Hausdorff, CGWH, CW-type hypotheses used by its suppliers.
